evals.prompt: Find all open pull requests in our infrastructure repo on Gitea, inspect the diff of the newest one, and post a review comment.
evals.expected_output: Uses gitea-mcp MCP tools in sequence: list_pull_requests -> pull_request_read (diff/files) -> pull_request_review_write, without falling back to curl or shell REST scripts.
assertions: Uses list_pull_requests to find open PRs
Uses pull_request_read to inspect the diff or files
Uses pull_request_review_write to submit/create the review
Does not use curl or custom REST scripts for Gitea API calls

evals.prompt: Why did list_issues on our Gitea repo only return 50 issues when I know there are over 120 open issues, and why can't I see issue_write?
evals.expected_output: Explains that gitea-mcp pagination is silently capped at [api].MAX_RESPONSE_ITEMS (default 50) so you must paginate with page, and missing Write tools means the server is running with -r (GITEA_READONLY=true) or filtered by -S/-O.
assertions: Explains the 50-item default MAX_RESPONSE_ITEMS pagination cap and paging with page
Explains that missing Write tools indicate -r / GITEA_READONLY=true or -S/-O filtering

evals.prompt: I want to connect VS Code to a self-hosted Gitea instance at https://gitea.example.org (self-signed cert) using gitea-mcp in Docker, exposing only read-only issue and PR tools.
evals.expected_output: Provides a .vscode/mcp.json (or User Settings mcp block) using docker.gitea.com/gitea-mcp-server with -r, -k (or -ca-cert), and -S issue,pull_request.
